additional_sections.section: 16.5.2.4 Several MIDI Tracks Playing the Same Instrument
additional_sections.paraphrase: Track In enters the receiving track input/recording stream; directly selecting the instrument bypasses recording and monitoring.
Direct plugin destinations can include a MIDI channel selector; this does not establish equivalent channel preservation at Track In.
All Channels is described as merged input. Original-channel preservation or remapping through Track In is not specified.
